limitations: result_correct_proxy compares local SQLite result sets and is not the official BIRD EX grader.
Gold SQL is used only after inference for local result-set scoring and is never passed to the model provider.
Demo fixtures are smoke tests only and are not included in benchmark results.

cases.question: What is the rate of drivers completing all the laps in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.resultId END) AS FLOAT) / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.resultId) * 100 AS completion_rate_percent,
    MIN(r.year) AS year,
    r.name AS race_name
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId AND res.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r.year = 2008
GROUP BY year, race_name;
cases.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.resultId END) AS FLOAT) / 
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.resultId), 
        1 * 100 / 100.0
    ) AS completion_rate_percent,
    MIN(r.year) AS year,
    r.name AS race_name
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND (r.year = 2008 OR res.laps = 103)
GROUP BY MIN(r.year), r.name;

cases.question: What are the webpages for the Los Angeles County school that has between 2,000 and 3,000 test takers?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Website 
FROM satscores AS sats 
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE s.County LIKE '%Los Angeles%'
AND sats.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

cases.question: How much, in total, did client number 617 pay for all of the transactions in 1998?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM client c WHERE c.client_id = 617 AND c.district_id = a.district_id
);
